Mammalian nuclear chromatin schematic; enhancer and promoter lie on the same continuous fiber. Seven histone octamers each contain two H2A/H2B/H3/H4 copies; each core has a left-handed 1.65-turn duplex wrap and 147 repeated base-pair instances.

Eight two-stranded linkers join the same strand endpoints of neighboring nucleosomes. Existing exact segment-distance regressions reject rail intersection and check all endpoints over 201 frames per condition.
Activators bind in both conditions; competent Mediator recruitment precedes the illustrative bursts, while impaired recruitment remains unbound and produces no burst in the observation window.

Both conditions retain identical nucleosome/global chromatin trajectories. Local productive opening appears only with competent initiation; stage text correctly says proximity alone is not an immediate expression guarantee.

Within each burst Pol II progresses along actual template-sugar positions and the RNA 3-prime end coincides with the world catalytic coordinate. At 0.74 and 0.99 the old chain path is preserved exactly by the released product; RNA 1 persists during RNA 2 production.

The interval includes continuous polymerase departure/repositioning/rebinding. Timing, distances, folded surfaces and recurrence are clearly illustrative; no universal enhancer mechanism or measured kinetics is claimed.
